admission.justification: Realized in one module, so the contract is proven rather than spread: the capsule-text cases hold that the installed copy is the generated one and that the launch record names which composition was used.

applicability: Every non-seat capability the product starts with shipped instructions.
conditions: The canonical source text ships in the package data.
exclusions: Seat role texts, which are compiled from the role capsule.
statement: The installed capability text a non-seat capability is started with is a generated projection of the canonical source: `load_capability_resource` reads it under `ar-capability-resource/v1`, enforces the shipped word budget and wording at the read, `compose_capability_capsule` composes a baseline, an addition or a replacement, and `capability_copy_drift` with `write_generated_capability_copy` keep the installed copy a generated copy so a hand-edited one is refused.
